# Branch-protection contract.
#
# main requires these status checks by EXACT name. Every entry here must be
# declared as a job `name:` in .github/workflows/ci.yml — the "branch-protection
# contract" step in the web job enforces that, so a rename fails loudly instead
# of silently blocking every future PR (#136).
#
# Keep these names short and stable and put descriptive detail in STEP names,
# which are not part of the contract and can be reworded freely.
#
# Changing a name here means updating branch protection in the same breath:
#   gh api --method PATCH \
#     repos/briggleman/kraken/branches/main/protection/required_status_checks \
#     -F strict=true -f 'contexts[]=<name>' ...   # all names, the array is replaced
#
# CodeQL is also required by protection but is reported by GitHub code scanning,
# not by a job in ci.yml, so it is deliberately not listed here.
pr title (conventional commits)
go
web
